title.rendered: Analyze Your Material in Real Time

content.rendered:
Van Dyk’s exclusive partnership with Greyparrot gives MRF owners and operators unprecedented access to their plant’s performance data.

How does it work?

Greyparrot’s waste intelligence platform uses easily mounted cameras to track materials passing on conveyor belts and identify items from over 89 waste categories. The camera units sit over your conveyor belts, gathering live images of your waste items. Those images are processed instantly by AI software that is trained on billions of data points. The data is reported immediately on a live dashboard, providing an inside look at plant sorting performance. Using Greyparrot’s live insights, recycling operators can act fast to optimize their process and increase their recovery.

TRACK YOUR WASTE

  • Characterize 89 different types of municipal waste
  • Identify material types with 98% count accuracy – even at speeds of up to 3m/s
  • Analyze waste stream composition by mass, with an average accuracy of 95%
  • Identify sleeved packaging and food vs. non food-grade material
  • Identify packaging by brand, SKU and size

 

Identify items by:

  • Material
  • Function
  • Food grade
  • Financial value
  • Brand

 

 

LIVE DASHBOARD

  • Optimize daily operations and existing infrastructure to recover more material
  • Automate sampling and compliance reporting to meet policy requirements
  • Take action when it counts with live customizable alerts
  • Build a data-driven business case on plant upgrades to ensure profitability
  • Guarantee product quality with detailed purity data
  • Improve staff safety by reducing contact with waste

 

 

APPLICATIONS:

  • Inbound stream – audit your incoming material 24/7 for 99% greater visibility into what’s on your tipping floor
  • Residue line – see how many valuables you are losing to residue (it could be hundreds of tons per month!)
  • Final QC lines – are you losing valuable materials to other product streams?
  • Retrofit planning – do you want to better understand what you are processing and where it’s going before making system improvements?

 

GET A QUOTE TODAY

 

To speak to an engineer about the advantages of Greyparrot, call 203-967-1100.
